draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.25, the 82nd-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 6th of 21 at S. He went 44th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (82nd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Kenny Vaccaro. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 65 tackles in 2019, 16th of 21 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the Cleveland Browns. 78 career games and 68 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (7 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 7 (90th percentile), season snap share 95.9% (88th percentile), combined tackles 89 (80th percentile). Versus the typical Year-6 safety who played: 95.9% season snap share against a median of 64.8%, above the norm.
